terms.definition: An installable unit with a plugin.json: its pages, sections, settings and declarations. Its files are installed in its plugin folder.
The file <id>-<version>.tgz of a plugin's files that sok plugin pack writes and that a registry lists.
The name in the package.json of a plugin or a sidecar, such as @scope/name; dependencies name plugins and sidecars by their package names.
The folder that plugins/installed.json records for an installed plugin.
A document of a plugin that a document region shows at sok://<plugin id>/<path>.
An address soksak://<owner>/<command> that opens from outside the application.
